_about: EVERY SHOT IS FELT (FIGHT SCREEN 11/14/26; VAMILY rule 450(b)(c), ask row 622; Paolo 11/14: 'anytime anyone fires a shot I want a muzzle flash on the screen, some quick shit, like it goes all white or something, I want people to feel this shot for real'). Every gun fired by anyone throws a flash at its barrel and a quick white hit across the whole screen, on the shot's own moment (the kick key, where its sound lands), bigger for a bigger gun. It must never strobe: shots inside volley_ms are ONE flash (the biggest gun's), and never more than max_per_second in any second (the web's own line for flashing, WCAG 2.3.1: three). SETTINGS' FLASH switch (boh.flash), MOTION: LESS and the phone's own reduce-motion setting all make it soft. One file a modder edits; read by slices/BOHEMIA_FIGHT.html (__EVERY_SHOT_IS_FELT__), held by gates/every_shot_is_felt_gate.js.
source: VAMILY rule 450; W3C WCAG 2.2 success criterion 2.3.1 (Three Flashes or Below Threshold); the gun kinds are slices/fight_rig/fight_rig.json guns.by_class (pistol, rifle, shotgun)
white_why: the white's peak over the whole screen by gun: a pistol is felt, a shotgun whites the street out; OUR DEFAULT, TUNING may move it
frames_why: 'a frame or two': the peak stands hold_ms (two frames at 60 a second) and is always drawn once even on a slow phone, then falls to nothing in fade_ms
soft_why: for eyes that cannot take flashing: the white at under a third, a slower fall, the barrel flash smaller; the shot is still seen
barrel_why: where the barrel's end is, in parts of the man's height: forward along his aim and up from his feet; the flash's size the same way; three inks from the white core out. Drawn two frames, in hard pixels, only on a man he can see (a shot out of the dark still whites the screen and is heard, but does not give the shooter away)
